# Module Map {#sec-module-map}

| Module | Wrapper | Core idea | Classroom project |
|---|---|---|---|
| chat | System prompt and transcript | The model is stateless; memory is resent | Personality bot, quiz bot, journal |
| rag | Search before the call | Evidence in the prompt | First RAG bot, PDF Q&A |
| agent | Tools and a loop | The model proposes; the harness runs | Calculator agent, custom tool |
| workflow | Folders and stages | Structure is readable and reviewable | Build a pipeline |
| loop | Repetition and a goal | Stop when the goal is met | Improve until good |
| eval | A judge | Score against criteria and calibrate | Judge your bot |
| vision | Image tokens | One more input type | The talking picture |
| voice | Speech converters | Ears and mouth around the chat loop | Smallest Pipecat |

## The shared shape

Every module is one model call plus a wrapper. Teach the shape first, then choose the module that fits the objective.

## What the lab is not

HandsOnAI is a learning lab, not a production framework. It deliberately leaves out retries, rate limits, observability, vector databases and large-scale evaluation. Those gaps are the next lesson, not a defect.
